answer: Recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments bind each agent to an accumulated history whose succinct proofs verify in constant time, while verifiable delay primitives force sequential work before any identity can claim standing; an adversary cloning identities confronts an oasis of unforgeable state, cannot transplant a lotus of attested lineage across fresh keys, and abandons the wharf of finality only by recomputing infeasible proofs, rendering Sybil spoofing information-theoretically hard.
